Base directory for this skill: D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime\.claude\skills\aliasbreaker

Run one AliasBreaker campaign following the protocol in CLAUDE.md exactly.

- CASE = the fixture path given in the arguments (e.g.
  `../data/cases/dev/case-101.json`).
- RUN = `runs/<run-id>` if a run id was given, else `runs/<case-id>-manual`.

Begin with `start`, follow the decision guidance, and end with `finalize`.
All hard rules in CLAUDE.md apply unchanged.


ARGUMENTS: ../data/cases/final/case-30002.json runs/final-case-30002-r2

input.command: python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-30002-r2 --slot 0 --why "Earliest reachable slot separates several live pairs at max separation, especially candidate 3 versus 0,1,2,4 and candidate 4 versus 0,1,2, giving broad discriminating power at minimal cursor cost"

python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-30002-r2 --slot 2 --why "This slot gives maximal four sigma separation for the leading pairs zero versus one, zero versus two, one versus five, and two versus five, covering most of the remaining probability mass at the earliest reachable epoch"

content.text: Only pair (0,5) is live now, with best separating slot at slot 9 (t=41.5671), sep=4.0σ. Take that slot to resolve.

input.command: python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-30002-r2 --slot 9 --why "Candidates zero and five are the only remaining live pair and this earliest slot gives the maximal four sigma separation between them"

content.text: Pair (0,5) remains the only live pair, now best separating slot is slot 34 (t=78.2347) at 4.0σ (earliest of the two 4.0-sigma options). Take it.

input.command: python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-30002-r2 --slot 34 --why "Candidates zero and five remain the sole live pair and this is the earliest reachable slot offering the maximal four sigma separation to push support past threshold"

python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-30002-r2 --slot 40 --why "This is the last remaining slot with meaningful separation for the sole live pair zero versus five, all closer slots have collapsed below one sigma"

content.text: No slots remain and support (0.817 vs 0.182 for candidates 0 and 5) has not crossed theta=0.997. Finalize as an honest abstention.

input.command: python -m aliasbreaker.cli finalize --run runs/final-case-30002-r2 --why "Candidates zero and five remain the only live pair with support 0.82 versus 0.18, below the 0.997 resolution threshold, and no observation slots remain to separate them further, so the honest verdict is an abstention"

content.text:
Campaign complete for `case-30002` (run `runs/final-case-30002-r2`):

- Used 5 of 6 observations.
- Slot 0 collapsed candidates 3 and 4; slot 2 eliminated candidates 1, 2, 3, 4, leaving 0 vs 5 as the sole live pair.
- Two further observations (slot 9, slot 34) each held that pair near a 4σ separation but only shifted support to ~0.78/0.22.
- Final observation (slot 40, the last reachable slot) pushed support to 0.817 (period ≈3.519d) vs 0.182 (period ≈1.405d) — still short of θ=0.997, and no slots remained.
- Finalized with an **abstention**: max_support 0.817, resolved=false, θ=0.997. This is the honest outcome given the data couldn't cleanly separate the final alias pair.
